crossrefs.text: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
He will speak to the people for you. He will be your spokesman, and it will be as if you were God to him.
He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.
Will you speak wickedly on Godʼs behalf or speak deceitfully for Him? Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?
Will you speak wickedly on Godʼs behalf or speak deceitfully for Him?
Bear with me while I speak; then, after I have spoken, you may go on mocking.
Behold, I know your thoughts full well, the schemes by which you would wrong me.
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion

He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap. He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor. For the foundations of the earth are the LORDʼs, and upon them He has set the world.
He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
but this is what I commanded them: Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people. You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.
If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land.
So now, correct your ways and deeds, and obey the voice of the LORD your God, so that He might relent of the disaster He has pronounced against you.
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
He opens their ears to correction and commands that they turn from iniquity.
In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a lavish banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.
The LORD sends poverty and wealth; He humbles and He exalts.

He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap. He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor. For the foundations of the earth are the LORDʼs, and upon them He has set the world.
He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
But will God indeed dwell upon the earth? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
Yet He has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness: He gives you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.”
Whether for punishment or for His land, He accomplishes this in His loving devotion.
Do you understand how the clouds float, those wonders of Him who is perfect in knowledge?
And God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.” And it was so.

Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, nor had any plant of the field sprouted; for the LordGod had not yet sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground. But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
And behold, I will bring floodwaters upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has the breath of life. Everything on the earth will perish.

In the six hundredth year of Noahʼs life, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened. And the rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
